description: Recommend looks for the business's website from Lokand's style library (14 hand-made looks, from a Michelin-style 'gastronomique' to a street 'bufe'), read from its menu, prices, logo and photos. Returns the three best fits, how bold to go (safe / distinct / bold, from how much material the business has) and why, and the whole library. Call this before a new look or a redesign, then get_style for the chosen look.
name: suggest_styles
title: Suggest styles
